signal: Virima announced a strategic partnership with HALO to power next-gen ITOM and service mapping and is expanding its team

email.body1:
Will, saw Virima announced its strategic partnership with HALO to power next-gen ITOM and service mapping.

A partnership like that usually opens more mid-market and enterprise IT accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Virima off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Will, quick follow-up for Virima.

New partnerships open co-sell motion faster than a team can chase it. Most groups don't know exactly how many meetings it takes to hit target, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Virima needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Will, last bit of proof for Virima.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Virima's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Will, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority for Virima this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters most right as the HALO partnership ramps, and I know that stretch is busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Virima either way.
